subject: FOI
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text: Dear Disclosure Team,  Re: FOI 260607013, my email of 7 June 2026 concerning probate records for Mary Williams of Great House Farm, Llandough  New information has come to light about historical and descriptive names for the Penarth-area site, including “Llandough Home Farm”. Please add the following forms to any relevant checks of your indexes, catalogues or transferred records for my original request. Its scope remains the location and access to probate records for Mary Williams, including wills, affidavits or ownership claims referenced.  The site is Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr beside St Dochdwy’s Church at Llandough-juxta-Penarth, near Penarth and Cardiff, Vale of Glamorgan (Heneb/GGAT HER GGAT02038s; RCAHMW NPRN 20182; grid reference ST16707335). Please distinguish it by mapped location from other Llandough farmsteads.  Farm and building forms: “Great House Farm”; “Great House Farm, Llandough”; “Great House Farm (GGAT02038s)”; “Great House”; “Great house”; “Greathouse”; “Tŷ Mawr”; “Ty Mawr”; “Ty-mawr”; “Ty Mawr Farm”; “Ty Mawr (Great House)”; “Ty Mawr, Penarth Road, Llandough”; “Cydfin Farm”; “Cydfin Farm or Ty Mawr Farm, (107 a.)”; “Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm”; “Cedfin”; “Cydwin”; “Cedwyn”; “Cedfyn”; “Cefin”; “Llandough Home Farm”; “Land Doc Home Farm”; “R-W-S-S Farm / Reese’s Farm”; “Llandough Church Farm”; “Church Farm”; “former Great House Farm”; “a 3.4 acre site located adjacent St. Dochdwy Parish Church”; “LLANDOUGH FARM (Ideal Homes Wales)”; and the map form “Ty-mawr”. Descriptive phrases that may also aid a search include “an 800-year-old house”, “the ten-roomed house”, “ancient Welsh house” and “the farm / the whole of the farm”; these are descriptions, not established property names.  Wider estate and associated-place forms, where relevant: “Cedwyn Estate”; “Cydwin”; “Cydfin Farm or Ty Mawr Farm, (107 a.)”; “Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm”; and “Cwm Cydfin Wood”. These are search aids for records concerning the wider area, not proof that all names denote one holding or establish the estate’s extent. “Cedwyn Estate” is the family’s working name, not a period name established by the cited records.  Locality forms: “Llandough-juxta-Penarth”; “Llandough near Penarth”; “Llandough near Cardiff”; “Llandough, Penarth”; “Llandough, Cardiff”; “Llandough”; “Landoche-juxta-Cardif”; “Llandough / Leckwith”; “Penarth Road, Llandough”; “Urban District of Penarth”; “Llandochau”; “CF64”; and “Church View Close, [postcode redacted]”. These are location search terms; “Landoche-juxta-Cardif” is a historical manor locator, and “Llandough / Leckwith” is neighbouring parish and manorial context, not another farm name. Llandough near Cowbridge and Llandow are different places and are outside the scope of this request.  The source qualifications matter: “Llandough Home Farm” is the wording on the checked 1881 census image; “Land Doc Home Farm” is a reported competing transcription. “R-W-S-S Farm / Reese’s Farm” does not appear on that checked page. “Cydwin” is a reported research lead whose underlying document has not been verified; “Cedfyn” and “Cefin” are retained search forms without a confirmed primary occurrence. The Bute catalogue’s 1552 - 1824 range is not a specific date for the Ty Mawr wording; the 1824 Stewart survey records “Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm”. “Llandough Church Farm” and “Church Farm” are source-specific terms whose connection to this site is not established. Please use map or archival context to distinguish them from separate farmsteads.  The nomenclature references are: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/nomenclature/c/great-house-farm/ https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/nomenclature/c/cedwyn-estate/ https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/nomenclature/c/llandough/ https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/wiki/great-house-farm/name-variations/ https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/wiki/great-house-farm/location-name-nomenclature/  Please rerun or extend the relevant checks and tell me which terms, indexes or series were checked and whether anything new was identified within the original request. This is a retrieval aid only and does not expand the request.  Yours sincerely,  Requester (Ret'd Sergeant) https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate
